terra.problem: Saying David is calmer than Papa assigns David a feeling that the text does not state or mark as a guess.
The wicked coming in swinging and falling on a floor adds actions and a setting the text does not give.
The war is hypothetical in verse 3, but the explanation treats it as happening.
David says he will keep his trust, not that he stays put or does not back away.
The explanation states that David is afraid of being left behind, but the text does not name that feeling.
Saying David is certain, not hopeful, creates a contrast the text does not make.
David has not been calling out the whole song. The explanation also says waiting does not mean being silent, which verse 14 does not address.
